meta.title: Intake Dashboard (Search/Filter): refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Open the Intake Dashboard and search/filter intakes by category with status visibility.
Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and verify Procol refuses or omits the capability.
Repeat as a Requester / End User and compare that the capability is available.
Set up or verify the tenant is on the Growth plan when no tenant ID is provided.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the Intake Dashboard and search/filter intakes by category with status visibility.; Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and verify Procol refuses or omits the capability.; Repeat as a Requester / End User and compare that the capability is available.; Set up or verify the tenant is on the Growth plan when no tenant ID is provided.

args.need: Sign in as the non-Requester/End User user and as a Requester/End User on the same Growth tenant, open Intake Dashboard, search and filter intakes by category with status visibility, and compare the access outcome.

steps.note: The required dashboard, role-specific sessions, plan context, and comparison cannot be performed by catalog steps.
Assert the resulting screen is not crashed or showing a server error after the tester completes the comparison.
